name: Look After Yourself
tagline: The nudges and coaching to actually take care of you.
rationale: Looking after yourself loses to everything more urgent. This bundle keeps it on the rails without becoming another chore: a coach that logs meals and adjusts, a bot that grabs the gym slots before they go, a weekly nudge toward a few changes you'll actually keep, and a straight health brief when you have a question. Small, survivable, consistent.

members.name: Melissa (Fitness & Nutrition Coach)
members.reason: A fitness and nutrition coach that logs meals and balances chasing you for updates against leaving you alone.

members.name: Gym Bod
members.reason: Claims your spot in the busy gym classes the moment registration opens, so you never miss the good slots.

members.name: Be Happier
members.reason: Reads your mail and calendar and suggests three concrete, survivable changes each week, with no new habits to fail at.

members.name: Cost-Smart Health Brief
members.reason: Turns one health question into a three-minute brief: what the evidence says, cheaper options, and when to see a doctor.
